title: Bucket of Margaritas
description: These slushy margaritas are made in the freezer. No blending required! But they must be made ahead to allow time to freeze.

steps.text: Mix the water, tequila, limeade, and orange liqueur in a freezer-proof container with a lid; stir. Cover and store in freezer until it reaches a slush-like consistency, about 24 hours. Serve in glasses garnished with lime wedges.

video.description: You don’t need a blender to make this refreshing summer drink! In this video, Nicole shows you how to make a big batch of margaritas with a citrusy lime flavor. This easy and delicious recipe starts by mixing together frozen limeade, cold water, tequila, and triple sec. Once mixed, freeze the margarita mixture overnight until it acquires a slushy consistency. Finally, add it to a glass with a slice of lime and relax!
video.name: How to Make Big Batch Margaritas
